info.name: Azure Application Gateway REST Application Gateways API

description.content: Azure Application Gateway is a web traffic load balancer enabling traffic management with features such as URL-based routing, SSL termination, and a Web Application Firewall. The REST API manages gateways, listeners, rules, and backend pools.
